facts.successful_steps: Home executes the next step recursively without advancing virtual time between steps.
facts.failed_step: Failure halts the remaining workflow steps.
facts.device_effects: A command acknowledgement does not imply its physical effect has completed; no implicit effect wait is inserted.
facts.dispatch_time: Registration maps start_time to a due tick; actual dispatch may be late or fail.
facts.phase_gaps: Separate requested times need separate scheduling; consecutive steps do not encode minute-scale phase gaps.

scope: Public API/source facts, not a user-goal contract or automatic action policy.
